what happens at each limit

Every tappable thing LOOKS tappable (read the screenshot as a first-time user)
every pop-up that can be closed leaves a way back to what it offered
Every user string in English and Hinglish: plain, true, consistent names for the same thing, no inside words, no banned words, no claims that are not live, Hindi read-aloud list for him
Every alert, push, WhatsApp, email: when it fires, to whom, on/off switch, sound on each phone maker (OPPO etc.), screen off, quiet hours, duplicates, "done means gone", watch bridging

App Store when iPhone ships
Also: rights to what we ship: exercise pictures and clips, music, voices, fonts, icons, open-source licences, the MettleUp name and logo
Fresh install, update over every older version still in use, data migration on update, sideload vs Play package, watch and phone on different versions, panel cache after deploy (old page still open)
How a gym is set up, moved (data import), helped (support window), billed, and offboarded
what the owner (you) does each day
help articles match the screens
every "contact us" path reaches someone
Also: keys, accounts and the one-person risk: every account, domain, signing key and token: who holds it, when it expires, what breaks if the laptop is lost, is there a written way back in
For every S1/S2 failure type: would we know before a gym tells us?
Error reports, crash reports, job failure alerts, a daily health line
Also: product measurement: which sign-up, activation, day-30 and paid numbers exist, and which decisions are made blind
Dead code, duplicated logic (two scorers, two date rules), silent catches, tests that check nothing, frozen areas, files no test touches
flaky tests
The same fact, word, colour, icon and rule is the same on panel, phone, watch, website and messages
Trace every value a user enters on one device (watch, phone, panel) to every place that should hold it (the other device, the saved record, the server, Health Connect): it arrives unchanged and stays
where a paired device cannot run in the cloud, trace it in the code

Per surface: extra taps to remove, missing states, what the top 3 apps in the category do better (named sources, dated), features members/owners ask for (feedback, enquiries), growth loops (referral, recommend-to-gym), store listing and website conversion
Write as "My view:" proposals, never built without his yes
A member, staff or outsider trying to cheat: fake check-ins, editing dues, scraping join links, spamming enquiries, using a gym's AI credits, sharing a Pro feature
Also: AI injection: can text typed by a member or lead steer the AI
Trial end, plan end, gym pauses or closes, member leaves and returns, staff leaves (access removed), owner changes phone, year end, leap day, app not opened for 6 months
List every setting, switch, plan gate, status and automation (from features.json + entities.json)
For EACH one, list every other feature whose result it SHOULD change (the AI ideas, Today, counts, badges, reminders, messages, help, exports, the phone app)
Then check in code that each of those really reads it
A should-read with no read = finding

For every automatic or "on" feature: write ALL conditions for it to reach one person (app installed, app linked by proven number, notifications allowed, phone maker rules, plan running, data filled in like birthday/phone, feature switch, version)
Then check: can the owner SEE, per member, who will get it and who will not, and why?
If the switch says "on" but some people silently get nothing = finding
Count real reach on Crispy Curves (e.g. "birthday wish: on, reaches 1 of 40 members")
Every automatic send, reminder, push, digest, job: is there a record the owner (or HQ) can open that says it went, to whom, when, and why not when it did not?
An automatic action with no record and no "why not" = finding (S2 when the owner believes it ran)
Find every pair of features that act on the same people or the same event (manual message vs automatic reminder; AI idea vs Today nudge; bell vs Today vs push; desk link vs phone proof)
Check they agree: no double message, no suggestion to do what the system already did, the same count in both places, "done" in one is "done" in the other
For every feature in features.json: is it on main, deployed, behind a switch, or waiting for a migration?
Compare code on main with what the live panel, HQ, website, phone app (Play version) and database really run (check the live version labels, list_migrations/catalog, switches)
Any feature the notes or What's new call live that is not live = finding
Output docs/system-map/LIVE-STATE.md (one row per feature: main / live panel / live DB / Play app), so he can always see what is really live
For every field a feature depends on (birthday, phone, check-in phone, app link, plan dates, trainer, batch): how many Crispy Curves rows have it filled?
Is there a screen that asks for it at the right moment?
A feature that depends on a field most rows lack = finding
Every new flow that fixes something only for NEW installs or NEW members (e.g. the phone sign-in shows only on new installs): what happens to existing users?
Is there a path for them?
None = finding

By script first: docs/system-map/_tools/silent.mjs lists every catch block with file:line and three flags: logs? (calls a log, report or crash function inside), tells_user? (sets an error state, toast or alert inside), rethrows?
Output _sources/silent.csv
Helpers read ONLY the rows where all three are "no", plus every fallback value (?? null, || [], ?? 0) that sits in a file named in a journey that writes money, messages, alerts, sign-in or sync
Everything else is counted in the grid as "filtered by script, N rows, not read" so the gap is visible
For each: if this path runs, does the user (or owner, or HQ) learn anything?
A silent path that hides a failed promise = finding

For each fact a user sees (count of alerts, dues, plan end, birthdays today, members using the app): list every place it shows (panel, Today, AI, bell, push, phone app, HQ, export) and compare the values on the Crispy Curves data and the ugly data pack
Any difference = finding

Every switch label, help article, What's new line and button that says what happens ("Members get a birthday wish", "Done items leave the bell"): read the code path end to end and confirm it happens for EVERY member the words cover
Words wider than reality = finding (tie to the promise register)
